verdict.rationale: Agent governance is a fair question for a Git forge, since such platforms can embed AI agents and offer group- or instance-level controls. However, nothing in the evidence shows Gitea letting admins enable or disable AI agents per organization or instance, or set allow/ask/deny policies for agent tools. The general user-permission and ACL features, and the existence of an official MCP server, are adjacent capabilities that do not deliver this story.
